---
title: "7.2_build_rank_lut"
output: html_document
params:
  curve: "q025"
  taxa: "mammals_birds"
  sdm: "ppm_rangebag"
  cells_to_remove_per_iteration: 1000
  pruning_iterations_per_stage: 100
  rank_method: "abf"
  rank_map_subdir: "benchmark_rank_maps"
  ana_subdir: "ana"
  stage_meta_name: "stage_meta.csv"
  species_csv: "Data/Clean/species_table.csv"
  patch_dir: "Data/Clean/Patches"
  grass_dir: ""
  lut_prefix: "lut_stage_"
  overwrite: true
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Build stage-level benchmark rank lookup tables for a completed script-6 run.
if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
}
```

```{r run_rank_lut}
source("R/stage7_rank_lut.R", local = knitr::knit_global(), print.eval = TRUE)
```

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
cat("\nStage 7.2 summary\n")
cat("=================\n")
cat("Curve: ", params$curve, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Taxa: ", params$taxa, "\n", sep = "")
cat("SDM: ", params$sdm, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Rank method: ", params$rank_method, "\n", sep = "")
if (exists("lut_root")) cat("LUT directory: ", lut_root, "\n", sep = "")
```
